blocks.passage:
Every country has a currency. When you buy or sell in another country, you have to change one currency into another. This is called currency exchange, or FX.

The problem is that rates move every second. Today the pound is strong; tomorrow it may be weaker. A small change in the rate can turn a profit into a loss.

For this reason, companies that trade across borders pay very close attention to FX. A little knowledge here protects a lot of margin.

items.q: What do you have to do when you buy or sell in another country?
items.why: "you have to change one currency into another. This is called currency exchange, or FX."

items.q: How often do exchange rates move?
items.why: "rates move every second."

items.q: What can a small change in the rate do?
options: Turn a profit into a loss
items.why: "A small change in the rate can turn a profit into a loss."

items.q: Why do cross-border companies pay close attention to FX?
options: Because rate changes can hurt their profit
items.why: Inferência: como o câmbio afeta o lucro, elas precisam acompanhá-lo.

items.q: According to the text, what does a little FX knowledge do?
items.why: "A little knowledge here protects a lot of margin."

audio.text:
Let me show you how a small change in the exchange rate changed the result of last month's shipment to the United States. It's a good, simple lesson in FX.

We sold goods to an American buyer for one hundred thousand dollars. Our costs are in pounds. So the question is: how many pounds do those dollars become?

When we agreed the deal, the pound was weaker, and one hundred thousand dollars was worth about eighty thousand pounds. That was our expected result — a nice profit.

But the buyer paid sixty days later. In those sixty days, the pound got stronger. And when a strong pound meets your dollars, you get fewer pounds. So the same hundred thousand dollars became only about seventy-seven thousand pounds.

That's three thousand pounds gone — not because we sold badly, but because the rate moved against us while we waited for payment. On a thin margin, that can be the whole profit.

The lesson: when you're paid in a foreign currency and you wait, the exchange rate is quietly deciding part of your result.

items.q: How much did the company sell the goods for?
items.why: "We sold goods to an American buyer for one hundred thousand dollars."

items.q: What was the expected value in pounds when the deal was agreed?
items.why: "one hundred thousand dollars was worth about eighty thousand pounds."

items.q: What happened to the pound over the sixty days?
items.why: "In those sixty days, the pound got stronger."

items.q: What did the $100,000 become in pounds after the rate moved?
items.why: "the same hundred thousand dollars became only about seventy-seven thousand pounds."

items.q: Why did the company lose about £3,000?
options: The exchange rate moved against them while they waited for payment
items.why: "the rate moved against us while we waited for payment."

items.q: A **currency** is…
items.why: Currency = moeda.

items.q: The **exchange rate** is…
options: how much one currency is worth in another
items.why: Exchange rate = taxa de câmbio.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the pound is **___**, you get fewer pounds for your dollars."
items.why: Stronger = mais forte (rende menos pounds por dólar).

items.q: A **loss** is…
items.why: Loss = prejuízo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "High **___** means the rate moves a lot."
items.why: Volatility = volatilidade.

items.q: "The rate **moved against us**." To move against someone means to…
options: change in a way that hurts them
items.why: Move against = mover contra, prejudicando.

items.q: "A rate change can **turn a profit into a loss**." This means it can…
options: make a gain become a loss
items.why: Turn a profit into a loss = transformar lucro em prejuízo.

items.q: "FX **eats into** your margin." To eat into means to…
items.why: Eat into = corroer, reduzir.

items.q: "Pay **close attention** to the rate." To pay close attention means to…
items.why: Pay close attention = prestar muita atenção.

items.q: "The rate is **quietly deciding** part of your result." Quietly here means…
items.why: Quietly = de forma silenciosa, sem se notar.
